family_reports.body: The system has retraumatized me repeatedly, increased my disability symptoms from the extra stress and trauma to the point that I can't work, caused my children to be traumatized from the acts and behaviors of the other party. It has left me bankrupt, put me back in an unsafe situation, with my children experiencing threats of harm from the other party. DV doesn't stop when you leave, the abuser weaponizes the legal system.
It had destroyed my children's mental health and mine. My youngest has became suicidal, which is everyday.

Destroyed my son mentally and emotionally, rubbed him of a childhood. I'm on 4 different anxiety meds, heart failure, autistic immune disease, debilitating depression. I trust no one, don't sleep, we both live in constant fear and anxiety

public_comments.comment_text: Was selected and hired even though judge attempted to explain a GAL is not necessary for our case. I had ZERO input, she literally gave bi-monthly reports to the court on allegedly MY CHILDS best interest. Probably would be beneficial if you HAD CONTACT WITH YOUR CLIENT TO MAKE THOSE RECOMMENDATIONS. Even provided another childs medical records during a hearing, stating my child had certain diagnosis. Her response when I brought it to her attention "oops".
